title: There is / there are
description: Es gibt … – Aussagen, Fragen und Kurzantworten
subject: Englisch

questions.prompt: There ___ a cat under the table.
questions.explanation: a cat = Einzahl → there is.

questions.prompt: Tippe is oder are ein.
questions.text: There {are} three pencils in my pencil case, and there {is} a ruler on my desk.
questions.explanation: Ein Ding (Einzahl) → there is. Mehrere Dinge (Mehrzahl) → there are.

questions.prompt: There ___ twenty-six children in our class.
questions.explanation: children ist die Mehrzahl von child → there are.

questions.prompt: There ___ two mice behind the cupboard.
questions.explanation: mice ist die Mehrzahl von mouse → there are.

questions.prompt: There ___ a new girl in our class.
questions.explanation: Ein Ding (Einzahl) → there is. Mehrere Dinge (Mehrzahl) → there are.

questions.prompt: There ___ lots of people in the park today.
questions.explanation: people (Leute) ist Mehrzahl → there are.

questions.prompt: Ergänze is oder are.
questions.text: In my room there {is} a bed and there {are} two posters on the wall. There {is} a lamp next to the bed.
questions.explanation: Ein Ding (Einzahl) → there is. Mehrere Dinge (Mehrzahl) → there are.

questions.prompt: Tippe is oder are ein.
questions.text: There {are} four books in my school bag. There {is} an apple in it too.
questions.explanation: Ein Ding (Einzahl) → there is. Mehrere Dinge (Mehrzahl) → there are.

questions.prompt: ___ a bike behind the house. (Kurzform von there is)
questions.explanation: Kurzform: there is → there's. Für there are gibt es keine übliche Kurzform.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
options: There are two dogs in the garden.
There is two dogs in the garden.
There's two dogs in the garden.
It gives two dogs in the garden.
questions.answer: There are two dogs in the garden.
questions.explanation: two dogs = Mehrzahl → there are.

questions.prompt: ___ there a computer in your classroom?
questions.explanation: Frage: is/are kommt vor there. a computer = Einzahl → Is there …?

questions.prompt: ___ there any cows on the farm?
questions.explanation: cows = Mehrzahl → Are there …?

questions.prompt: Are ___ two teachers in the room?
questions.explanation: Frage: Are there …? – nicht Are they …?

questions.prompt: Choose the correct question.
options: Is there a park near your school?
There is a park near your school?
Is it a park near your school?
Are there a park near your school?
questions.answer: Is there a park near your school?
questions.explanation: Frage: is vor there stellen. a park = Einzahl → Is there …?

questions.prompt: ___ children in the playground?
questions.explanation: children = Mehrzahl, Frage → Are there …?

questions.prompt: Bilde die Fragen.
questions.text: {Is} there a sandwich in your bag? {Are} there any pens on the desk? {Is} there a dog next to the door?
questions.explanation: Einzahl → Is there …? Mehrzahl → Are there …?

questions.prompt: Tippe is oder are ein.
questions.text: {Is} there a cinema in your town? {Are} there many shops?
questions.explanation: a cinema → Is there …? many shops → Are there …?

questions.prompt: Ergänze die Fragen.
questions.text: {Are} there five people in your family? {Is} there a garden behind your house?
questions.explanation: people = Mehrzahl → Are there …? a garden → Is there …?

questions.prompt: Is there a lake ___ Munich?
questions.explanation: Städte: in Munich.

questions.prompt: Is there a TV in your room? – No, there ___. (Kurzform)
questions.explanation: Kurzantwort mit Kurzform: No, there isn't.

questions.prompt: Tippe die Kurzantworten ein (Kurzform bei No).
questions.text: Are there two cats in your house? – Yes, there {are}. Is there a hamster? – No, there {isn't}.
questions.explanation: Bei Yes keine Kurzform: Yes, there are. Verneint: No, there isn't.

questions.prompt: Are there any sweets in the box? – No, there ___. (Kurzform)
questions.explanation: Mehrzahl verneint: No, there aren't.

questions.prompt: Is there a clock on the wall? – Yes, there ___.
questions.explanation: Yes, there is. – bei Yes nie Kurzform (nicht: Yes, there's.)

questions.prompt: Is there a ball under the bed? – Yes, …
questions.explanation: Kurzantwort mit Yes: immer Langform → Yes, there is.

questions.prompt: Are there any mice in the kitchen? – No, …
questions.explanation: Frage mit Are there → Antwort mit there aren't.

questions.prompt: Ergänze die Kurzantworten.
questions.text: Is there a pool at your school? – No, there {isn't}. Are there computers? – Yes, there {are}.
questions.explanation: Einzahl → is/isn't, Mehrzahl → are/aren't. Bei Yes keine Kurzform.

questions.prompt: Tippe die Kurzantworten ein (Kurzform bei No).
questions.text: Are there horses on the farm? – Yes, there {are}. Is there a pig? – No, there {isn't}.
questions.explanation: Yes, there are. / No, there isn't.

questions.prompt: Are there any people at the bus stop? – Yes, …
questions.explanation: people ist Mehrzahl (Leute) → there are.

questions.prompt: Is there a cake in the fridge? – No, there ___. (Langform)
questions.explanation: Langform: No, there is not. Kurzform: No, there isn't.

questions.prompt: Es gibt einen Hund im Garten.
options: There is a dog in the garden.
It gives a dog in the garden.
There are a dog in the garden.
It is a dog in the garden.
questions.answer: There is a dog in the garden.
questions.explanation: es gibt = there is/there are – niemals it gives!

questions.prompt: Es gibt zwei Bäckereien in unserer Straße.
options: There are two bakeries in our street.
It gives two bakeries in our street.
There is two bakeries in our street.
They are two bakeries in our street.
questions.answer: There are two bakeries in our street.
questions.explanation: es gibt + Mehrzahl → there are. „It gives“ ist falsch.

questions.prompt: Es gibt eine Katze auf dem Sofa. → ___ a cat on the sofa.
questions.explanation: es gibt + Einzahl → there is (there's).

questions.prompt: Da sind drei Hefte auf dem Tisch. → ___ three exercise books on the table.
questions.explanation: da sind + Mehrzahl → there are.

questions.prompt: Gibt es eine Bushaltestelle? → ___ a bus stop?
questions.explanation: Frage: Is there …? (nicht: Gives it …?)

questions.prompt: Gibt es Füchse im Wald? → ___ foxes in the forest?
questions.explanation: Mehrzahl, Frage → Are there …?

questions.prompt: Übersetze: Es gibt einen Rucksack hinter der Tür.
questions.explanation: es gibt = there is; hinter = behind.

questions.prompt: Übersetze: Da sind zwei Fahrräder neben dem Haus.
questions.explanation: da sind = there are; neben = next to.

questions.prompt: Da ist ein Brief unter deinem Buch. → There's a letter ___ your book.
questions.explanation: unter = under.
